values.note: First come, first served: self-register within one hour of placing the camping unit on a site. No unit may occupy a site more than 14 days in any 19-day period. Check-out 4 pm. Only shelters and youth group camping are reservable.

booking.source: https://delawarecounty.iowa.gov/conservation/ (Campground Rules and Regulations, read 2026-11-04): 'Camping is on a first come first serve basis – No Reservations - except Youth Group Camping', 'Two Week Rule - No camping unit shall occupy a campsite more than 14 days out of any 19 day period'; campground map: 'Self-registration must be completed within 1 hour of placing camping unit on campsite. Check-out time is 4:00 pm.'

values.note: Usually mid-April through mid-October; walk-in access only in late fall and winter.

season.source: https://delawarecounty.iowa.gov/conservation/conservation-parks/ (read 2026-11-04): 'Campgrounds are usually open from mid-April through mid-October.', 'facilities are closed to vehicle traffic and allow only walk-in access during the late fall and winter season'; mycountyparks: 'Parks with campgrounds are usually open from mid-April through mid-October.'

note: Delaware County Conservation park 3.5 miles southwest of Delhi on the Lake Delhi impoundment of the Maquoketa River, home to the lake's two main public boat ramps. The camping loop sits in woods south of 267th Street, set back from the lake behind the road and the boat-ramp area. --Claude
summary: County pages + 2024 campground map + 2026 season notice: 26 sites (24 water/electric at $25, 2 primitive at $15), vault toilets, dump, mid-Apr to mid-Oct. Booking corrected: first come, first served by self-registration, no reservations (stored reservable/operator came from note prose). Lakefront looks wrong - see flag. Note trimmed and its 'reservable via mycountyparks' removed.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (down): stored lakefront has no per-entry evidence (bulk commit dbf58c6). The county's campground map and NAIP show every RV site in a wooded loop SOUTH of 267th Street, a public road; Lake Delhi lies north of the road behind a strip of trees and private lake homes, ~100-150 m from the nearest sites (1A, 2A, 15A, 16A, 24A), and the Turtle Creek bay to the east is ~120 m away past the boat-ramp loop's parking and day-use area. No site has open ground to the water and no official photo shows the lake from a site, so after every source this goes down to not waterfront.

BOOKING: county rules say 'Camping is on a first come first serve basis – No Reservations'; the stored reservable:true/platform operator (note prose) is wrong and is corrected here. MyCountyParks lists no bookable campsite facilities for this park.
